data.one_liner: Framework and support code for building plugins for the Dart analysis server.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to write custom Dart static analysis plugins that run in IDEs and at the command line via dart analyze and flutter analyze. Enables building custom analysis rules, IDE quick fixes, and quick assists.
use_when: You want to build custom static analysis rules for Dart and Flutter codebases
You want to provide custom IDE quick fixes and quick assists for specific code patterns
avoid_when: You are just looking for standard lint rules that already exist in lints or flutter_lints
You do not need to write custom analysis server plugins
strengths: Empowers custom static analysis integration in IDEs and command line tools
Supports writing rules, quick fixes, and quick assists easily
weaknesses: Requires maintaining custom analyzer dependencies and plugin integration
Not documented beyond basic guide references
